name: ArcChain / head

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Head exploding like a ripe pumpkin: deep wet pop, crunchy rupture, broad pulp splatter and dripping.  Element: A wet tissue rupture and high voltage snap, followed by three separated branching watery electrical arcs, liquid sputters and a sustained crackling Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
